whatis.intro: Retail margin is the share of the shelf price a store keeps once the item is paid for. It is the number store buyers plan in. For a distributor, the store's unit cost is your case price split by the pack, so your price sits inside their margin.

cards.title: The store's share of the tag
cards.body: The gap between the tag and the unit cost, divided by the tag. A $2.38 unit on a $3.97 tag keeps $1.59, which is 40.1%.
cards.alt: Plus sign, for what a store keeps on each tag

cards.title: Gross, before the store's running costs
cards.body: The store's labor, rent and power for the cold case. Retail margin is gross, so all of that is paid out of it later.
cards.alt: Minus sign, for store costs that sit outside the margin

cards.title: Why a supplier runs it
cards.body: Shelf space goes to the lines that earn the store money. Your case price is the one input in that margin you control.
cards.alt: Light bulb, for the case price inside a store's margin

who.h2: Who uses a retail margin calculator
who.intro: Sales teams at DSD and independent distributors that sell into stores run it to see the shelf from the store buyer's side. Anyone who meets a buyer, suggests a shelf price or defends a line should run it first.

look.h2: Store numbers to confirm before quoting margin
look.intro: Two of the inputs come from the store's side, and both drift. Confirm all three below before a margin goes in front of a buyer.

steps.title: The tag on the shelf today
steps.body: Use the price the store charges now, not the suggested price on your sell sheet. Stores move tags without telling their suppliers.

steps.title: The store's cost after allowances
steps.body: If you pay a store a billback or a promotional allowance, take it off their unit cost for the weeks it runs. Leave it in and their margin reads lower than they see it.

steps.title: The unit the shelf really sells
steps.body: Split the case by the units that scan. A 12-unit case sold as six twin packs has a different unit cost and a different tag.

vos.h2: Where VOS fits with your store accounts
vos.h3: The case price behind their margin
vos.body: VOS does not calculate a store's margin or set its shelf price. It keeps your side clear: each store orders by voice in the VOS app from a guide at the prices you set.
